request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply:
**Obamacare raised federal spending for coverage and appropriations, with ACA taxes, fees, and savings offsetting some costs; the sources reviewed do not provide one comparable net budget figure.**

- CBO and JCT projected ACA health-related revenue provisions would raise $391.7 billion over 10 years. (R41128, PDF p. 4)
- CBO estimated that fully funding ACA-authorized discretionary grant programs would require almost $100 billion in appropriations over FY2012–FY2021. (R41390, PDF p. 7)
- The ACA included more than $100 billion in appropriations over FY2010–FY2019, including $40 billion for CHIP in FY2014 and FY2015. (R41301, PDF p. 2)

Not yet covered: No quote-backed net deficit estimate at enactment was located; the available reports provide older estimates covering different periods and budget components.
reply.reasoning: CRS reports show major mandatory outlays for coverage expansion and ACA appropriations, alongside projected health-related tax revenues. Because these estimates have different scopes and periods, they cannot establish a single net impact.
